title: Miami World Center Block F-East
address:
150 NE 8th Street
Miami, Florida 33132
United States
description: This three-story, 135,000-square-foot building sits within Miami Worldcenter, the 27-acre mixed-use development taking shape in downtown Miami. Locals call it the Jewelry Box. The ground and second floors are built out for retail, and the roof above was designed as usable outdoor space rather than left as a mechanical deck.
